units.source_text: [\[9\]](#part1334.html#w9) 中古时代贵族人家有来客时，于别室焚香，

en.t: [9] In the medieval period, when guests came to an aristocratic household, incense would be burned in another room,

units.source_text: 或将香炉藏在隐处，使来客但闻香气，不见香源。

en.t: or the incense burner would be hidden away, so that guests could smell only the fragrance without seeing where it came from.
